sections.h2: About 101 million Indians have diabetes, and state rates differ widely

chart.title: Diabetes prevalence runs from 4.8% in Uttar Pradesh to 26.4% in Goa
chart.sub: Share of people surveyed with diabetes, %.
chart.source: ICMR-INDIAB, Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology 2023, as reported in the press.

sections.means: The spread between states is wide, and the national figure is a projection from a survey run from 2008 to 2020.
sections.todo: Quote the ICMR-INDIAB figure with its survey dates and projection caveat, not the older claim about who uses intense sweeteners.

sections.h2: Sucralose imports rose 49.3% in value in FY26 as the unit price fell

chart.title: Volume grew faster than value, so the unit price fell 12.4%
chart.sub: Change on FY25 for sucralose imports under tariff line 29321400, %.
chart.source: This blog's trade registry; customs data.

sections.means: Sucralose is the one intense sweetener this blog's registry singles out, with a $27.7 mn trade deficit.
